name: DNS Record Tester
description: Check domain registration data, DNSSEC deployment and reverse DNS in one place.

hints.whois: RDAP over HTTPS is tried first, falling back to the whois protocol (TCP 43).
hints.ptr: Reverse lookup also performs a forward lookup to expose mismatches.

faq.q: Why are some whois fields empty?
faq.a: Some registries restrict queries or redact fields; missing values are returned as empty strings.
It walks DS records and queries DNSKEY to determine whether a chain of trust anchor exists.

faq.q: What does a PTR mismatch mean?
faq.a: The reverse record points at a name that does not resolve back to the same address, which is a configuration gap.
